title: Power Rangers Season 4 Zeo
description: A team of teenagers with attitude are recruited to save Angel Grove from the evil witch, Rita Repulsa, and later, Lord Zedd, Emperor of all he sees, and their horde of monsters.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x1
episodes_data.description: In the rubble of the destroyed Command Center, the Power Rangers find the Zeo Crystal.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x2
episodes_data.description: The Rangers face their greatest challenge as Zordon explains that King Mondo is preparing to invade the Solar System, his final link in a chain of galaxies he already controls.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x3
episodes_data.description: When Mondo and Machina unleash the Staroid on the Zeo Rangers, they are forced to call on their untested Zeo Zords.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x4
episodes_data.description: The computer software that Rocky, and his new friend Jennifer are working on, is stolen by the Cogs and used against the Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x5
episodes_data.description: Tommy and Katherine take care of a baby for a school assignment giving King Mondo an idea for his evil ambitions.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x6
episodes_data.description: The teens' baseball team provides the perfect outlet for Prince Sprocket to do battle with the Rangers when he turns their batting machine into the People Pitcher.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x7
episodes_data.description: Smokey, a specially trained dog, aids the Zeo Rangers in fighting Digster, Mondo and Machina's latest monster.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x8
episodes_data.description: When Ernie brings a puppet show to the Youth Center to entertain the children of Angel Grove, Mondo and Machina hatch a plan to control the children's minds, by planting a transmitter on the Puppet Man.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x9
episodes_data.description: Prince Sprocket recruits the Rangers to be in his own twisted movie; "Invasion of the Ranger Snatchers."

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x10
episodes_data.description: As Billy learns he has accumulated enough credits to graduate from Angel Grove High, Cestro, the Blue Alien Ranger, lands on Earth seeking Billy's help.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x11
episodes_data.description: As Rocky and Adam work on developing hybrid plants for Botany class, Rocky's plant exhibits weird behavior, growing rapidly and developing an appetite for metal.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x12
episodes_data.description: A mysterious musician in Angel Grove High is pursued by Prince Sprocket and King Mondo.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x13
episodes_data.description: Tanya and Adam are exploring the new world of cyberspace with the help of Raymond, a computer whiz, at school. When they run into a computer virus, Mondo gets the idea to create Mean Screen, a horrible computer monster that will infect all of the computers in Angel Grove.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x14
episodes_data.description: As Billy is returning from Aquitar in a space capsule, Machina and Mondo attack his space craft, sending it into the gravitational pull of the Machine Skybase.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x15
episodes_data.description: Tommy receives a "Dear John" letter.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x16
episodes_data.description: Mondo and Machina send the Defoliator to create a greenhouse effect in Angel Grove.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x17
episodes_data.description: As Katherine tries to console Tommy about his "Dear John" letter from Kimberly, a spark of attraction begins to form between the two Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x18
episodes_data.description: On a journey to find True of Heart, Tommy comes upon the incredible discovery of a young man who looks just like him.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x19
episodes_data.description: Searching for the other half of an arrowhead, Tommy discovers its owner is his brother.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x20
episodes_data.description: Having kidnapped Tommy's newfound brother David, King Mondo blackmails Tommy into giving up his half of the arrowhead, in order to set David free.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x21
episodes_data.description: Now that he has both halves of the arrowhead, King Mondo vows to destroy the Zeo Rangers, while continuing to refuse the release of Tommy's brother.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x22
episodes_data.description: King Mondo sends down the Defector robot to trick the Zeo Rangers into gaining their trust, and thereby able to destroy them.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x23
episodes_data.description: Adam experiences a nightmarish scenario when the Machine Empire invades Earth overnight and transforms many of Adam's friends into sinister scientists, werewolves, and dark forces.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x24
episodes_data.description: Bulk's infatuation with the daughter of a high ranking officer soon puts both his, Skull's, and Lt. Stone's careers in jeopardy.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x25
episodes_data.description: Tanya's potential new singing career divides her time between fulfilling an ambition and serving as a Ranger

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x26
episodes_data.description: King Mondo attempts to rule the Earth's waterways by building a fleet of ships under an invisible field.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x27
episodes_data.description: King Mondo's plan to divide and conquer the Zeo Rangers is spoiled by the appearance of the Gold Ranger.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x28
episodes_data.description: The other Rangers must find a way to help their friends when Prince Sprocket shrinks Tommy and Katherine and places them in a terrarium with a hungry spider.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x29
episodes_data.description: Katherine competes in a surfing competition, but faces danger when the Leaky Faucet monster puts toxic Cog oil in all the water in Angel Grove.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x30
episodes_data.description: The Somnibot casts a sleeping spell on the people of Angel Grove, leaving it to the Gold Ranger to break the spell.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x31
episodes_data.description: The Gold Ranger finds asylum in the Power Chamber from the evil Mondo, Machina, and the Varox bounty hunter.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x32
episodes_data.description: When the Gold Ranger is attacked by Varox Bounty Hunters, Pyramidas is hit, and falls into the seas of the planet Aquitar.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x33
episodes_data.description: Time is running out for transference of the Golden Powers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x34
episodes_data.description: King Mondo is determined to use the Damocles Sword to destroy the Zeo Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x35
episodes_data.description: The teens are helping Ernie set up for his new Beach Club when a group of tough teens ride in and begin to trash the place.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x36
episodes_data.description: The teens are involved in a charity fashion show for the famous designer, Mr. Stenchy.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x37
episodes_data.description: Aisha sends Tanya a map of Mysterio Island, the island on which Tanya suspects her parents have been missing for years.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x38
episodes_data.description: When Katherine stages a ballet about King Midas, Louie Kaboom creates the Midas Hound, an idol that changes everything into gold.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x39
episodes_data.description: A practical joker wrecks havoc on Angel Grove High. While Bulk and Skull try to track down the trickster, Prince Sprocket's brother, Prince Gasket and sister-in-law, Archerina, arrive with a few new tricks of their own!

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x40
episodes_data.description: While jet skiing on the lake, Tommy is mysteriously disappears.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x41
episodes_data.description: The Zeo Rangers discover that Tommy has been captured by Prince Gasket, and placed in a large arena with monsters battling one another.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x42
episodes_data.description: The Gold Ranger is forced to defend himself when the brainwashed Tommy attacks him.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x43
episodes_data.description: Tommy is confused when he keeps reliving experiences of the day over and over.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x44
episodes_data.description: The teens all dress in classic mystery character costumes when they participate in a charity dinner organized by Detective Stone.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x45
episodes_data.description: Tommy asks Tanya for voice lessons when he has to sing in front of the class.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x46
episodes_data.description: Everyone is stunned when it is revealed that Billy has aged into an old man.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x47
episodes_data.description: The Power Rangers Zeo team up with the Alien Rangers of Aquitar to combat a double threat from King Mondo and Lord Zedd.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x48
episodes_data.description: The golden powers start to fade from Jason.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x49
episodes_data.description: Jason, who is continuing to lose the golden powers, is confronted by Rita and Lord Zedd.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers 4x50
episodes_data.description: The Rangers, together with their friend Raymond, help Ernie set up for a multicultural holiday banquet, and in the process learn how different cultures celebrate the holidays.
